profile.summary:
I’m Dr. Alice Vo Edwards — a high school computer science and cybersecurity teacher, PhD researcher, AI policy expert, PMI-CPMAI and seasoned operations leader with over 20 years of experience across tech, healthcare, nonprofit, and government sectors.

My career blends rigorous research, data analysis, and ethical technology oversight, with a proven track record of driving people-centered innovation. As a co-author of the IEEE 7010-2020 standard for assessing the impact of AI systems on human well-being, I bring deep expertise in AI ethics, risk evaluation, and responsible innovation.

Whether supporting organizational strategy as a fractional executive (COO/CFO/CPO), contributing to policy and compliance frameworks, or leading research and program evaluation, my work is grounded in evidence-based decision making, cross-functional collaboration, and impact.

I’m particularly passionate about the intersection of AI, social impact, neurodiversity, and equity, and often serve as an expert advisor or witness in legal and regulatory contexts involving emerging technologies.

positions.title: Chief Everything Officer, Mad Scientist & Software Developer
positions.description:
I'm the person who gets overly excited about ethical AI and will excitedly talk about it while laying face down on a massage table alternately giving my masseuse a mini lecture  and brainstorming new project ideas that I somehow turn into working code (or add to my backlog - the backlog is LONG). As the founder of VoEd Technologies, I wear all the hats (unless I'm floating around wearing a mermaid tail instead) - harnessing my ADHD superpower of visionary as well as my hyperfocus abilities to do everything from dreaming up solutions that make AI more responsible, to coding them into existence, to making sure projects actually ship on time.

My days are split between asking "but is this ethical?", "why isn't this compiling?" and "I'm not sure it's pretty enough?"- which keeps life interesting! I specialize in turning complex AI ethics concepts into practical solutions that businesses can actually use without losing sleep over unintended consequences.

When I'm not debugging code or managing timelines, you'll find me geeking out over the latest in responsible AI development, sketching project ideas in my notes app, or explaining to someone why AI bias matters (and yes, I have slides ready).

Currently building the future of ethical AI, one thoughtfully-coded project at a time. Because someone has to make sure our future robot overlords know how to treat us with all the best care! 

*Passionate about: Responsible AI • Ethical Technology • Turning Ideas into Reality • Coffee-Driven Development*

positions.title: Principal Consultant | AI & Workplace Ethics Expert | Advisory Board Member
positions.description:
As Founder and Principal Consultant at WorkingEdge Inc., I provide high-level advisory and consulting services at the intersection of AI ethics, neurodiversity, organizational psychology, and workplace risk. My work includes:

Conducting AI bias audits and advising on ethical AI governance strategies

Supporting law firms and legal teams as an expert witness in cases involving AI systems, workplace harm, neurodiversity discrimination, or ADA compliance

Consulting on neuroinclusive hiring, onboarding, and accommodation practices for forward-thinking organizations

Coaching high-performing professionals and executives with ADHD to optimize their focus, productivity, and leadership presence

Serving as a fractional C-suite advisor (CFO/COO) to help purpose-driven businesses and nonprofits scale sustainably

Contributing thought leadership and public policy insight grounded in my co-authorship of the IEEE 7010-2020 ethical AI standard
positions.insights: Skills: Expert Witness Support · Workplace Investigations · Trial Consulting · Human Factors Analysis · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description:
Enjoying the hands-on practice of watching social cognitive career theory play out before my eyes and hopefully encouraging students towards positive pathways as a CCSD high school teacher of multiple enormously fun and exciting subjects. I don’t think anyone views a school day quite the same as someone who’s studied social cognitive career theory long enough to complete a dissertation on it. It’s quite heartwarming, really. I have a fabulously fun time teaching students Computer Science, Cybersecurity and Marketing based on my 20+ years real world experience. A day in the life of a student might include being reminded that resume writing isn’t just for a future manager, it must first be written to beat those dastardly HR bots and get your resume in front of a manager so you can be interviewed in the first place unless you have the social capital to network your way into getting your resume plucked from the depths of the endless queue of applicants. Oh and yes you can use ChatGPT but don’t be an idiot about it. You have to know what output you want and fine tune what you ask ChatGPT to have it just help you wordsmith “babysitting” to sound more accomplished than just having kept your sibling from drinking toilet water. 

I help teachers, too. With ChatGPT and other mentorship, developing and sharing materials, etc. Also lead TSA chapter and support multiple other CTSOs including SkillsUSA - last year had several of our teams with top placements at state for TSA and SkillsUSA but each year is a new and exciting challenge!

*Received Exemplary Employee Award December 2024 Computer Science Education Week

HR oversight, recruiting, training, and planning staffing growth from 40 to 400+ staff

experience.title: Chief Everything Officer, Mad Scientist & Software Developer
experience.description:
I'm the person who gets overly excited about ethical AI and will excitedly talk about it while laying face down on a massage table alternately giving my masseuse a mini lecture  and brainstorming new project ideas that I somehow turn into working code (or add to my backlog - the backlog is LONG). As the founder of VoEd Technologies, I wear all the hats (unless I'm floating around wearing a mermaid tail instead) - harnessing my ADHD superpower of visionary as well as my hyperfocus abilities to do everything from dreaming up solutions that make AI more responsible, to coding them into existence, to making sure projects actually ship on time.

My days are split between asking "but is this ethical?", "why isn't this compiling?" and "I'm not sure it's pretty enough?"- which keeps life interesting! I specialize in turning complex AI ethics concepts into practical solutions that businesses can actually use without losing sleep over unintended consequences.

When I'm not debugging code or managing timelines, you'll find me geeking out over the latest in responsible AI development, sketching project ideas in my notes app, or explaining to someone why AI bias matters (and yes, I have slides ready).

Currently building the future of ethical AI, one thoughtfully-coded project at a time. Because someone has to make sure our future robot overlords know how to treat us with all the best care! 

*Passionate about: Responsible AI • Ethical Technology • Turning Ideas into Reality • Coffee-Driven Development*

Contributing thought leadership and public policy insight grounded in my co-authorship of the IEEE 7010-2020 ethical AI standard

experience.title: Teacher
experience.description:
Enjoying the hands-on practice of watching social cognitive career theory play out before my eyes and hopefully encouraging students towards positive pathways as a CCSD high school teacher of multiple enormously fun and exciting subjects. I don’t think anyone views a school day quite the same as someone who’s studied social cognitive career theory long enough to complete a dissertation on it. It’s quite heartwarming, really. I have a fabulously fun time teaching students Computer Science, Cybersecurity and Marketing based on my 20+ years real world experience. A day in the life of a student might include being reminded that resume writing isn’t just for a future manager, it must first be written to beat those dastardly HR bots and get your resume in front of a manager so you can be interviewed in the first place unless you have the social capital to network your way into getting your resume plucked from the depths of the endless queue of applicants. Oh and yes you can use ChatGPT but don’t be an idiot about it. You have to know what output you want and fine tune what you ask ChatGPT to have it just help you wordsmith “babysitting” to sound more accomplished than just having kept your sibling from drinking toilet water. 

I help teachers, too. With ChatGPT and other mentorship, developing and sharing materials, etc. Also lead TSA chapter and support multiple other CTSOs including SkillsUSA - last year had several of our teams with top placements at state for TSA and SkillsUSA but each year is a new and exciting challenge!

*Received Exemplary Employee Award December 2024 Computer Science Education Week
